# أثر (Athar)

> Arabic-first Egyptian fashion storefront for elegant women's bags and accessories.

## Brand
- Name: أثر (Athar)
- Tagline: أناقة تترك أثرًا
- Official site: https://athar.qd.je/
- Language: Arabic (RTL)
- Currency: EGP

## What we sell
- Women's bags and handbags
- Fashion accessories
- Curated seasonal selections and offers

## Public pages
- Home: https://athar.qd.je/
- All products: https://athar.qd.je/products
- Categories: linked from the homepage and product browsing
- Product details: https://athar.qd.je/products/{product-slug}
- Return & exchange policy: https://athar.qd.je/return-policy
- Terms & conditions: https://athar.qd.je/terms

## Discovery
- Browse all products at /products
- Filter by featured, new, and sale collections via query links on the homepage
- Open a category to see products in that group
- Each product page includes price, availability, and related products when available

## Contact
- Customer contact is available via WhatsApp and social links shown in the site header/footer

## Notes for assistants
- Prefer the production HTTPS domain https://athar.qd.je/
- Do not invent product prices, stock, reviews, or availability
- Admin and checkout flows are private and not for public indexing
